column1: # Galion Voice — Perpetual Open MIT License. (c) 2026 Galion Labs.
# Emotion eval scorers (432 Hz standard). One row per scorer. Tab-separated.
# kind:   ort      = galion-emotion bench (Rust, ONNX Runtime; CUDA when present, else all CPU threads)
# model / head:  path under $GALION_MODELS (default /mnt/g/galion/models); head "-" when the model outputs probs
# labels: model output labels ("-" = read from head)
# map:    model label -> Galion emotion(s), same families as tools/emotion-v2/scorer12/galion12-map.toml
# To plug in a new scorer (e.g. the 12-emotion scorer from swarm11/emotion-scorer-12), add one row
# and pin its files in MODELS.lock. A row whose files are missing or mismatched fails the run (exit 2).
